title: Grateful Dead Live at Family Dog at the Great Highway on 1970-02-27
venue: Family Dog at the Great Highway

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording of a classic early‑70s show highlighted by an epic Lovelight and solid performances of Good Lovin', Easy Wind and Dancin'.
ai_review.review: The SBD source captures the band with remarkable clarity – reviewers rave about the crisp, A+‑grade mix despite a few minor vocal/high‑hat quirks. Musically the concert shines thanks to a monumental NFA → Lovelight sequence, plus strong renditions of Good Lovin', Easy Wind, Hard to Handle and Dancin'. Overall the performance is praised as one of the standout Family Dog dates of 1970.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (mostly 4‑5) and enthusiastic comments about both the music and the soundboard quality lead to a strong combined score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the mix as crisp, A+ and “very good sound for ’70”, with only minor complaints about vocal/high‑hat balance and a brief cut on Casey Jones.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early‑70s Family Dog set with occasional sloppiness but overall solid flow; the second half builds momentum around Lovelight and maintains energy through Good Lovin' and Easy Wind.

band_member_comments.Phil: Multiple reviewers call Phil’s bass “phenomenal”, “thumps away” and note his harmony work as unbelievable.
